title: Fantastic sunset trip.
text:
Great trip!
Very relaxing & enjoyable, a must to see the beautiful sunset. 
The entertainment was lovely by a lady singing & playing the guitar. 
Make sure you go to the desk to exchange your voucher for a ticket prior to joining the queue which is right beside where the boat leaves from. 
Highly recommend this trip.

title: Short and sweet boat tour
text: This tour was fun! You leave the dock around 7:45 and stroll up the coast slowly for about 40 minutes before turning back and catching the sunset. We were originally scheduled to attend the tour the day before, but there was thunder/lightning and rain. Thankfully they pushed us to the next day, but they wouldn’t allow us to cancel because they were “still going out.”
